description: Microsoft Word 2010 is open with a document containing regional sales team meeting notes. The document includes quarterly revenue figures listed as plain text: Q1: $45,200, Q2: $52,100, Q3: $48,900, Q4: $61,300. Select this quarterly data and insert a table with two columns (Quarter, Revenue) and four data rows plus a header row. Apply borders to all cells in the table and bold the header row text. Save the file using Ctrl+S.
